issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 08 uses a wildcard SELECT (*) (solution_repository/aufgabe08.sql lines 1) while the problem statement explicitly requires outputting specific columns: Name, Landkreis, Fläche and the Einwohnerzahlen (problem_statement.md lines 141-144) and also instructs students to "Gib immer genau die geforderten Daten aus und nicht mehr." This mismatch can confuse students about the expected output and contradicts the stated requirement to return only the requested columns.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the solution to explicitly select only the required columns (e.g. SELECT name, kreis, flaeche, einwohner_m, einwohner_w FROM Gemeinde WHERE (einwohner_m > 50000 AND einwohner_w > 50000) OR flaeche > 100) so the solution matches the problem statement's requirement to return exactly the requested fields. Alternatively, if selecting all columns was intended, update the problem statement to allow SELECT * and clarify which extra columns are acceptable.
